name: Cognizant
description: Cognizant is an IT and business services firm that builds, runs and modernises software and operations for large clients, with most staff in India. It sells AI and technology services, consulting, application development, systems integration, quality engineering, infrastructure and business-process work, plus some licensed software. Revenue is reported by four client industries. Fixed-price contracts made up $10.0 billion of 2025 revenue. It buys back shares aggressively (authorisation $15.5 billion) and pays a dividend.

employees.note: About 256,900 in India, 41,600 in North America, 14,600 in Continental Europe, 7,800 in the UK.

businessLines.name: Health Sciences
businessLines.how: Fees from health-sciences clients for IT, digital and operations services, billed mainly on fixed-price or time-and-materials contracts (fixed-price work was $10.0 billion of total 2025 revenue across all segments); the 10-K also says Cognizant licenses and supports some software and platforms.

businessLines.name: Financial Services
businessLines.how: Fees from financial-services clients for technology services, consulting, application development, systems integration and operations, on fixed-price or time-and-materials contracts.

businessLines.name: Products and Resources
businessLines.how: Service fees from clients in this industry segment; the 10-K says segment margin was diluted in 2025 by the Belcan acquisition and by resales of third-party products in integrated offerings.

businessLines.name: Communications, Media and Technology (CMT)
businessLines.how: Service fees from communications, media and technology clients for technology and operations services.

brands.name: Belcan
brands.note: Acquired in 2024; contributed 260 basis points of 2025 revenue growth; sits in Products and Resources.

brands.name: TriZetto
brands.note: Named in the 10-K (13 mentions); which segment holds it and its revenue were not read.
